newsitem.title: GERMANY: Commerzbank - Montgomery cost under $200 mln.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank - Montgomery cost under $200 mln.

text.p: Commerzbank AG said on Tuesday that it paid considerably less than $200 million to buy U.S. firm Montgomery Asset Management.
Asked by reporters to comment on speculation the price was around $250 million, Commerzbank Chief Executive Martin Kohlhaussen said: "I cannot confirm this price, it was much less than $200 million."
Kohlhaussen added that he did not expect the bank to make any further such acquisitions during 1997.
"I can't see that at all right now," Kohlhaussen said.
Commerzbank announced in March it had bought Montgomery Asset Management, which has about eight billion dollars of funds under management.
Montgomery Asset Management was sold to Commerzbank by San Franciso-based investment banking firm Montgomery Securities.
